hydration.name: Sip a potion of water
hydration.description: A glass of clear water with each meal. Simple, and quietly powerful.

exercise.name: Practise nimble footwork
exercise.description: Stretch, stroll or dance for twenty minutes to keep your limbs spry.

sleep.name: Draw the bed-curtains early
sleep.description: Retire at a steady hour so tomorrow's magic has proper rest.

reading.name: Read from a tome
reading.description: Fifteen minutes with a good book to feed your curiosity.

mindfulness.name: Steady your inner flame
mindfulness.description: Five quiet minutes to breathe deeply and gather your focus.

screentime.name: Dim the enchanted glass
screentime.description: Set the phone aside half an hour before bed and let your mind unspool.

diet.name: Brew something green
diet.description: Add a portion of vegetables or fruit to today's feast.

other.name: Daily practice session
other.description: A short daily moment to check in on your studies and your spirits.
